shortDescription: Three z-levels (sky/surface/basement) in ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling/needs/work/storage come free from vanilla. Per-band biomes, Caverns basements, ~4× faster gen, full-mesh elevator — sky mountains with despeckled generation, cliff faces, a five-terrain plateau, and now an alpine pass: tarns, rim scree and exposure-thinned flora.
body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED**. Current tree: ~57 files / ~13,100 LOC.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`; bands along **+z**; permanently-fogged gutter between bands; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)×64` — **64-alignment is load-bearing**. Map sizes curated (126 / 190 / 254).

### The one insight
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum; `Reachability.CanReach` works **unpatched** — we patch nothing in `Reachability`/`PathFinder`/region traversal.

### Dividing line
Graph/logic = FREE. Geometry/presentation = NOT free; fix per draw/compute site. Reachability-as-proxy consumers (wander roots fixed; joy/meditation/pens un-audited).

### Hard 1.6 constraints
Jobified pathfinder · no `PathFinder.FindPath` · `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells.

### Generation-window rules
Carve in `GenerateContentsIntoMap` postfix · `TryPendingSurfaceRect` for genstep-time band math · start-spot clamp + `RescueStrandedColonists` + `CarveStartClearing` on zero-standable surfaces (also fires on ocean tiles; "solid rock" wording is a mislabel).

# 2. ⚠ THE LOAD BOUNDARY (root-caused, fix pending verification)
Cache poisoning: `ConstructComponents()` creates a transient EMPTY `ABBandMap` that mid-load rendering latches. Fix: `CompOf` never caches while `Scribe.mode != Inactive` + `FinalizeInit` rebinds all caches. Also: uniqueID-keyed statics → CWT; load camera move deferred. **Verify: menu-load · load-while-playing · double cycle.**

# 3. PER-BAND BIOME / CAVERNS — verified
`GetBiomeAt` prefix (cell param) · sky biome locked to surface · Biomes! Caverns basements. Watch: perf-mod biome caching · stalagmite leak · Earthen Depths temp.

# 4. CAMERA — verified. `viewBand` · `CurrentViewRect` clip · `ABBandCurtain` = `MapEdgeMaterial` at WorldClipper altitude.

# 5. MAP GEN — ~4× faster, closed (crowdedness mechanism; doomed-band plant skip).

# 6. RUNTIME PERF — 59.6 fps @96 pawns, mod ≈2% frame. All rendering is bake-time section-mesh geometry: zero per-frame cost. **Alpine pass adds the first real runtime content cost — see §9.**

# 7. SEE-BELOW / BORDER STACK
Event-driven sky sync; below-draw prints + translates. Shared `ABNineFan` (vanilla 9-vert cell fan). Below fog = vanilla corner smoothing sampled one band down · below edge shadows via `ABEdgeShadowGeometry` (verbatim vanilla corner blocks, extracted once) · meadow fade = neighbour ground's own world-position material as a fade fan over the mass cell · rooftop fade via TerrainHard→TerrainFadeRough shader-swapped clone + AlphaAddTex (**shader assignment resets renderQueue — set queue after**) · drop-off EdgeShadow ring in open-air cells bordering the mass.

# 8. SKY-MASS PRESENTATION — settled, **verified in play ("everything looks great")**
Options mocked up in `docs/mockups/ledge-options.html`. User chose **A+B → D → E**, C parked.

### ⚠ THREE REJECTED ATTEMPTS — do not revisit
1. **Force-linked wall masks** (run 25): flattened the wall band into the near-flat mask-15 tile.
2. **High-queue cover**: shipped regression — erased overhanging sprites (tree tops, plants); mask-15 slab.
3. **Wall-sprite suppression + fog re-predicate + shadow scoping** (DELETED): looked great, broke *legibility* (minable rock read as walkable floor) and carried two vanilla-layer replacements as compat risk.

**Settled: vanilla sprites always draw; redundant outlines are a GENERATION problem.** Cap layer skips natural-rock cells (opaque sprite) and fogged cells. **Despeckle** (2-pass majority filter; conversions require all 8 neighbours in-mass ⇒ rim and ledge-band invariant untouched) killed the nested rings at source. **One central fog hole** (`ComputeFogMask`: wall depth ≥3, components <24 cells dropped).

### Option A — terrace ring + plateau palette ✅
Ledge band ≥1 cell is an **invariant** (plateau needs `edgeDist ≥ 2`; `TerraceWidth()` ≥ 1). Five-terrain palette from fertility noise × an INDEPENDENT moisture Perlin: rough stone → gravel → soil → rich soil → rare mud. All natural + FadeRough ⇒ vanilla blends ground↔ground free. Field underlay on open mass cells (`naturalTerrain`, world-position, uv-free, `lowQueue`); atlas edge tiles at `lowQueue+1` only when mask≠15.

### Option B — south-facing cliff face ✅
`CliffFaceDepth = 2` (0 disables), `FaceDarkest = 0.42`. Southern rim cells carry a vertical brightness ramp across field quad + edge tile + corner fillers. Vertex colour multiplies the terrain shader ⇒ rock detail survives the shading. Face lives inside rim cells we own (open-air cells belong to see-below sprites at cutout queue).

### ORE GLYPH BUG — fixed
`GroundRockAt` accepted any mineable edifice **including ore**; ore defs have **`naturalTerrain == null`** (`TerrainDefGenerator_Stone` skips `isResourceRock`) ⇒ a "never happens" fallback drew `AtlasBaseFor(ore)` — the whole linked **atlas sheet** — on a 0..1-uv cell quad ⇒ glyph soup. Fix: `IsHostStone()` gate on both `GroundRockAt` branches (top above a vein types from HOST STONE) + the atlas fallback **deleted** (atlas bases are only valid via `MaterialAtlasPool.SubMaterialFromAtlas`). Lore saved.

# 9. OPTION D — ALPINE PLATEAU (2026-07-29, untested)
Third generation pass over the band, ordered: **tarns → rim scree → flora** (shoreline before scatter; flora last so it plants against finished terrain). `Classify` now hands back its `edgeDist` field via an out param — tarn placement and flora exposure both need "distance to a drop", and recomputing the BFS would risk disagreeing with the classifier.
- **Tarns** — small alpine lakes, `WaterShallow` + `Mud` fringe, ~1 per 1100 eligible interior cells (cap 4), deterministic per-cell jitter for an irregular shore. **`MinTarnEdgeDist = 6`, enforced PER CELL not on the seed**, so the blob clips itself against the rim (user rule: never near an edge — a lake lipping a cliff needs option E to make sense). **Shallow only, deliberately**: deep water is impassable, and an impassable pocket on a plateau reachable only via wormhole stairs is a stuck-pawn report waiting to happen. Skipped when `naturalPeaks` is off.
- **Rim scree** — real haulable stone chunks via the `"Chunk" + defName` convention (`GetNamedSilentFail`, so modded stone works). Restricted to the rim shoulder (`edgeDist` 1–4) so chunks read as having tumbled from the edge. **Deliberately NOT falling back to `building.mineableThing`** — for some rocks that's blocks or an ore product. `RimChunkChance 0.014`, `MaxRimChunks 60`: **user chose real chunks knowing each is a Thing a hauler will eventually want to carry downstairs** — hence the hard cap.
- **Exposure-thinned flora** — `rim01 = clamp01((edgeDist-1)/8)`; spawn chance × `Lerp(0.30, 1, rim01)` so growth thins toward the rim, and tree weight × `Lerp(0.05, 1, rim01)` so trees effectively refuse to stand on the shoulder. Still gated by `skyVegetationDensity` and per-cell `fertilityMin` (open water/mud flats fall out on fertility).
**Cost:** the first feature with genuine runtime cost (plants tick + draw, chunks are Things). **Measure the gen delta with ABGenProfile** — plant spawning was the driver we cut 16.9 s → 4.2 s. Snow line deliberately deferred (needs a per-band temperature offset in `ABBandEnv`; changes gameplay, not just looks).

# 10. VERTICAL LINKS — elevator SHIPPED (untested). Full-mesh 2×2 `AB2_Elevator`; shaft collapse; legacy-save migration. Known: `Carry` latent hole.

# 11. BETTER MOUNTAINS COMPAT — code-complete, co-load test deferred.

# 12. DIAGNOSTICS
band info · transit health · below pawn report · stuck probe · watchdog · transit logging · below layer report · lighting report · bisect toggles · biome report · shader report · ABGenProfile · cap corner filler toggle · `CliffFaceDepth`.

# 13. OPEN WORK
1. **Verify option D**: tarns present, irregular, never near a drop, wadeable · rim chunks on the shoulder only and not swamping the map · flora visibly thinner at the rim with trees inland · **gen-time delta measured, not assumed**.
2. **Confirm the ore fix** (compacted steel / machinery veins read vanilla; top above a vein is host stone).
3. **Verify reload fix** (menu-load, load-while-playing, double cycle).
4. **Verify elevator**.
5. **Option E — waterfalls**: river raised at gen, lower level filled to perimeter, fall lip = raised water adjacent to `ShowsBelow`, capped/zoom-gated mist flecks + sustainer. **Water spike FIRST** — below-view water rendering is the unproven risk. NOTE: tarns do NOT de-risk this; they are same-band water, whereas E needs *surface* water seen through open air.
6. Option C (stepped mesa) parked · snow line (needs per-band temp) · COMBAT never verified · mountain sun-shadow parked · vertical conduit · compat audit · transplant · reachability-proxy audit.

# 14. LESSONS (telegraphic)
Measure, don't reason · crowdedness drives destroy cost · reuse the engine's object · fog softness lives in EXPLORED neighbours' fans · classify terrain by PROPERTY not def identity · **NEVER hide sprites that carry gameplay information** · **visual noise in a generated field is a GENERATION bug: despeckle the content, don't hide the decoration** · **ore defs have no naturalTerrain/leaveTerrain (the stone generator skips isResourceRock)** · **a Graphic_Linked's base material is the whole ATLAS SHEET — only via MaterialAtlasPool.SubMaterialFromAtlas; drawn flat it reads as rows of glyphs** · **"can't happen" fallbacks are what the player photographs — make bad states unrepresentable** · **enforce spatial rules PER CELL, not on the seed + radius arithmetic** · never a queue-above-cutout cover · clip custom geometry to cells you already own · vertex colour on terrain materials dims the real texture (multiply) · statics keyed by game-scoped ids leak — CWT · never cache comps while Scribe active · FinalizeInit = worker thread · altitude ≠ draw order but IS the cutout depth tiebreaker · material.shader assignment resets renderQueue · green build proves nothing about reflectively-instantiated classes · **when art is locked in asset bundles, playtest screenshots are a legitimate mockup source**.

# 15. PUBLISHING
Store page honest (update after verification). known-issues.json v2 (no-elevator + hard-fog-squares entries stale). Live item **3773267907**.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true`. Companions: `astryl.Circinus` + `astryl.ModernDevTools` + `BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns` + `BiomesTeam.CoreFramework` (+ BM only for compat runs). New colony for banding; reload tests need load-while-playing. Transit logging + watchdog reset every launch.
